title: Eval collects softmax probabilities
description: Extend src/evaluate_classifier.py: optional --probs-output writes per-sample CSV (filename, true_label, pred_label, p_damaged, p_not_damaged) using softmax over logits; p_damaged = column 0 (label 0 = Damaged). Default decision threshold stays 0.50 so existing metrics/confusion reproduce unchanged. Device auto-select cuda>mps>cpu preserved.
acceptance_criteria: --probs-output CSV has columns filename, true_label, pred_label, p_damaged, p_not_damaged
p_damaged + p_not_damaged sums to ~1.0 per row
Metrics without --probs-output byte-compatible with pre-change output (threshold 0.50)
p_damaged maps to class index 0 = Damaged
